items.text:
Hi Dev,
Your spring parking permit is ready. Stop by the Transportation Office in Baker Hall between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM, Monday through Thursday. Bring your student ID and a $15 fee. We can't hold permits past May 9.
Thanks,
Ms. Alvarez

questions.stem: According to the email, what should students bring to the Transportation Office?

options.C: A printed copy of the permit confirmation

questions.explanation: The email tells students to bring their student ID, which is another way of saying a student identification card.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about permits that are not collected by May 9?

options.A: They will no longer be available for pickup.
options.B: They will be mailed to students' homes.
options.C: They will be charged an additional fee.
options.D: They will be transferred to another student.

questions.explanation: Because the office states it cannot hold permits past May 9, students who arrive later will most likely find that their permits are no longer being kept for them.

items.text: Okay, the Taco Loco truck parked behind the student union is genuinely the best lunch deal on campus! Today only, from 11:30 AM to 2:00 PM, every taco is $3 — cash only, and they sell out fast. Get there before the line reaches Wells Hall!

questions.stem: According to the post, what is true about the taco special?

options.A: It runs until late in the evening.
options.C: It offers free drinks with each taco.
options.D: It is available every day this week.

questions.explanation: The post specifies that the tacos are cash only, meaning customers must pay with cash.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about a student who arrives at 2:15 PM?

options.A: They will find the truck parked at Wells Hall.
options.B: They will pay a higher price for their tacos.
options.C: They will be able to order from a limited menu.
options.D: They will likely have missed the special.

questions.explanation: The special ends at 2:00 PM and the post warns that the food sells out quickly, so arriving at 2:15 PM means the deal is almost certainly over.

items.text:
Hello Tomas,
Your Lot C parking permit has been approved. Pick it up at the Campus Safety desk in Ridley Center on Friday, March 3, after 8:30 AM. You don't need to pay there — the $25 fee is already on your student account.
Regards,
Mr. Boyd

questions.stem: According to the email, where should Tomas collect his permit?

options.A: At the student accounts window in Ridley Center
options.B: At the Lot C entrance gate on Friday
options.C: At the Campus Safety counter in Ridley Center
options.D: At the parking office downtown before March 3

questions.explanation: The email directs Tomas to the Campus Safety desk in Ridley Center, which is paraphrased here as the Campus Safety counter in Ridley Center.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the $25 permit charge?

options.A: It has already been taken care of.
options.B: It must be paid in cash at Ridley Center.
options.C: It will be refunded if the permit goes unused.
options.D: It covers parking in every campus lot.

questions.explanation: Since the fee is already posted to his student account and he is told not to pay at the desk, the payment has effectively been handled.

items.text:
Hi Nadia,
Just confirming our session: Thursday at 3:00 PM in Room 112 of the Learning Commons. Please bring your essay draft, notes, and questions. Your first visit is free; later sessions cost $8 each. Try to arrive five minutes early.
Best,
Mr. Okafor

questions.stem: According to the email, where will the tutoring session take place?

options.A: In a study room at the main library
options.C: In the writing center on the second floor

questions.explanation: The email states the session is in Room 112 of the Learning Commons.

questions.stem: In the email, the word "draft" most nearly means:
questions.explanation: In this context, a draft is an early, preliminary version of the essay that the tutor will review.
